items.coder_A: Gliosarcoma is named only as one example of eligible malignant brain tumours (mainly paediatric); conditions list only paediatric brain tumour.
items.reason: Inclusion names gliosarcoma ('recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumor including, but not limited to, infant-type hemispheric glioma, gliosarcoma, intracranial sarcoma and WHO Grade II ependymoma'), so the trial passes S5 under C7; glioma is enrolled alongside non-glioma brain tumours (intracranial sarcoma), which D31-B15 codes basket_gbm_eligible.

note: Passes S5 as basket_gbm_eligible (D31-B15; gliosarcoma named in inclusion alongside non-glioma tumours). Fails S6: the only intervention is an NK cell therapy (excluded_intervention_type).

revisions.reason: Eligibility enrols gliosarcoma and infant-type hemispheric glioma alongside non-glioma tumours such as intracranial sarcoma.
